events.content: Audrey: Hey Andrew! Good to see ya! What's been up since we last talked?
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Hey Audrey! So, I started a new job as a Financial Analyst last week - it's been quite a change from my previous job. How about you? Anything interesting happening?
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Congrats on the new job! So I got these new collars and tags for my dogs - so cute!
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Thanks! That sounds cute. Can I see a picture?
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: [Image: a photography of two dogs are standing in the grass with their mouths open] Sure! See them with their new collars, cute right?
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Cute little guys! What are their names and how long have you had them?
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: I've had them for 3 years! Their names are Pepper, Precious and Panda. I can't live without my little ones!
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: That's awesome! Have you always wanted a dog, even with living in the city? Can they still go on adventures?
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Absolutely! They're city dogs and we explore all the time. They love trying out new parks and trails. We go on adventures together very often.
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Wow, sounds like they make life so awesome! Kinda jealous of all those fun outings with them.
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: They really do! It's great how much happiness they bring. Do you have any pets?
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: No, no pets right now. But I do love animals.
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: That's great to hear! Animals are truly amazing. Do you have a favorite animal?
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: I've always been awed by birds. Their power to soar and explore new spots is amazing.
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Yeah, birds are amazing! I can imagine it feels incredible to soar and see the world from up high. Do you have a favorite type of bird?
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: [Image: a photo of two birds flying in the sky with a sun shining behind them] Eagles have always mesmerized me; they're so strong and graceful!
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Yeah they're beautiful. Do you go bird-watching? It must be awesome to see them up close.
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Haven't specifically gone out for bird-watching, but I do spot them when I hike.
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Nice, spotting pretty birds while hiking must be great. Do you have any favorite hiking spots?
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Fox Hollow is a great trail to hike on weekends; the views are awesome!
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Cool, gonna give it a try. Thanks for the suggestion!
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: No problem! Let me know how you like it. Have fun hiking!
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Thanks! I'll let you know. Have a good one!
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Take care and have a good one! See ya!
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: [Image: a photo of a small white dog sitting on a carpet] Hey Andrew, I got a surprise for you! We adopted another puppy called Pixie. She's SO cute! Isn't she just the cutest?
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: That's awesome! Pixie is so cute! Did you ever check out that hiking spot we talked about last time?
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Thanks! I know right? She's so cute! Pixie's been keeping us busy, so I haven't had a chance to check out that hiking spot yet.
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Yeah, I get it. A puppy really takes some work. Has she settled in okay? Is she getting along with the other pups?
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: [Image: a photography of a dog playing with a group of other dogs] Pixie's fitting in great! It took her a few days to get used to the other dogs, but now they're awesome friends. They love playing and exploring the house - so cute!
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: That's awesome! Is Pepper adjusting well to her?
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: [Image: a photography of two dogs standing in the grass near a fence] Pepper took a bit to get used to her, but now they're always together!
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: That's great to hear! I'm considering getting a dog too, but it can be challenging finding a dog-friendly place in the city. Do you have any tips on finding such a place?
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: [Image: a photography of a dog sitting in a field of flowers] We used websites that helped us find a place that allowed dogs. They had filters that made it super easy. Found a perfect spot thanks to them!
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Wow, that's so cool! I'll give those websites a try, thanks for the info!
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: You got it! I hope you find a great spot soon!
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Thanks! Fingers crossed for the apartment and that furry friend.
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: I'm keeping my fingers crossed for you to find a great furry friend and an apartment.
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Hope I find one soon. Can't wait!
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: You'll love them! They're great for cuddles and companionship.
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: [Image: a photo of a dog sitting on a couch in a living room] It'd be so great to have a furry buddy to cuddle and hang with. Here's a photo of my family's dog on a couch.
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: [Image: a photography of a dog laying on a couch with a pillow] Our furry friends make great cuddle buddies. Here's one of them enjoying some lazy couch time!
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: [Image: a photo of a man walking a dog on a trail] That pic is so cute! It would be fun to hang out with a dog, cuddling away. Got me thinking of my old hiking pics and how much I miss exploring nature trails with my family's dog. Ah, the peaceful moments out in nature!
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Taking them on hikes must be awesome! That makes me want to hike with my dogs.
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: [Image: a photography of a man sitting on a rock with a dog] Hiking with a dog is way fun, it's a great way to bond and create memories together.
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Yeah! Exploring nature with them and making memories is awesome!
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Definitely! I miss those moments. I need to find a dog-friendly spot soon so I can get exploring again!
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Yep! I hope you find the perfect dog-friendly spot soon so you can make new memories with them.
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Thanks! I'll keep looking until I find it. Super excited for what's next!
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: So excited for you! I can't wait to see where you and your furry friend decide to hang out. All the best!
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: I'll keep you posted. Ttyl, Bye!
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Andrew: Hey Audrey! What's up? Missed chatting with ya! Check it out, my girl & I tried out that new cafe scene in the city last weekend! Super fun but kinda sad not being out in nature - that's when I feel like I'm really thriving. Oh man, I miss the peacefulness of being out on a hike.
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Hey Andrew! That cafe sounds pretty awesome, glad you enjoyed it. Yeah, I know what you mean. That feeling of being out in nature, surrounded by beauty and peace, is unbeatable, compared to being surrounded by concrete jungles.
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Yeah, being out in the nature really has a way of taking my breath away. It's like a home for my soul! I feel connected when I'm there.
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: I totally get it. Nature has a way of bringing us back down to earth and reminding us that we're part of something bigger. It's amazing.
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Yeah, it's like hitting the reset button when life gets too chaotic. Nature has a way of being really soothing.
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Definitely! For me, taking my dogs for a walk in the park helps me find my center and recharges me.
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: I hear ya. Can’t do that here unfortunately, city living makes it hard. Really miss that connection and companionship.
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Must be tough living in the city without the opportunity to go outside. Sure is a different experience.
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Yeah, it really does. Sometimes it feels like I'm missing out.
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: It must be tough. City life can get overwhelming, so it's great to find ways to connect to nature. What kind of things do you like to do in the city?
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: My girlfriend and I love to discover new places to eat around town. It's a great way to try something new and wind down after a long week.
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Wow, that sounds like a great way to explore the city! Trying new places and food is always fun. Have you discovered any new favorite spots recently?
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: We found an awesome cafe with amazing pastries - the smell was just irresistible!
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Sounds amazing! Did you take a photo? I'd love to see!
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: [Image: a photo of a bakery display with pastries and coffee] Yep, I got them! Check out this photo of the delicious pastries we had at the cafe.
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Wow, they look great! What did you get? Now I'm craving pastries!
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: They taste great too! We had some delicious croissants, muffins, and tarts! It was amazing!
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: [Image: a photo of a muffin pan filled with blueberries and muffins] Wow, sounds amazing! Glad you got to enjoy them. Since you metioned pastries, I made some of my favorite treats last week. Let's have a pastry party sometime!
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: That looks delicious! A pastry party sounds awesome, count me in!
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Awesome! My dogs will tag along. My furry friends would love it!
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Definitely! They'll have a great time at the party! Can't wait for the party!
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Same! Looking forward to it. This would be a good chance for you to hang out with them.
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Yeah! It's gonna be awesome to see all of them together and chowing down. Super excited!
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: [Image: a photography of a dog running with three other dogs in the background] Yay! This'll be awesome! Seeing them all together, having fun and enjoying treats is the best. I can't imagine life without them, they bring so much joy.
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Aww, so cute! I bet their happy faces means a lot to you.
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: [Image: a photo of a woman with a tattoo of a dog and sunflowers] I know right? They mean the world to me. So much that I got tattoos of them on my arm.
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Wow, that tattoo looks great!
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: [Image: a photography of a woman walking with her dogs in the woods] Thanks! I got it a while ago. It represents my love for my pups and nature's beauty.
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Aww, that's cute! What made you getting the tattoo?
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: I've always had a strong bond with them – they make me so happy, and I just want to see their happy faceseven when thry're not with me.
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: That's awesome, I'm glad they bring so much joy into your life.
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: [Image: a photography of a hummingbird sitting on a branch with its wings spread] Hey Andrew! Long time no talk! Last week I finally went on a hike and had this amazing experience with a hummingbird. It was so cool watching it dart around with its wings! Nature is so beautiful.
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: [Image: a photo of a view of a lake and mountains at sunset] Hey Audrey! Glad to hear from you. That hummingbird was awesome! Nature's the best. Remember I was feeling down because I couldn't get out more? Well, good news - I found a new open space to hike nearby - feels so refreshing!
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: That looks great! How often are you able to go hiking now?
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: So I usually try to escape the city at least once a weekend - it's my much-needed break!
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Nice! I Bet it's great to get away like that.
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: [Image: a photo of a mountain range with a sunset in the background] Yep! Nature is so therapeutic for me. It's hard to put into words how great it feels to be surrounded by greenery or standing on top of a mountain breathing in the fresh air. So peaceful and invigorating.
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Wow, that view looks great! It really captures that calming and peaceful feeling. It must be really satisfying to capture that tranquility.
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Yeah! I try to capture those special moments and share that feeling with others.
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: That's really cool! Spreading that peaceful feeling to others is such a great way to bring happiness and motivation.
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: I agree! It brings me joy to spread that feeling and motivate people to find their own peace - it's like a ripple effect, spreading positivity.
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Absolutely. Not only the receiving end feels great, the person spreading it will feel great as well!
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Yeah, it's crazy how that can bring such great joy and calm to people.
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Yeah, by sharing something can make a big difference to others.
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Yup! We don't realize it, but even the littlest gestures can have a big effect. Spreading good vibes and joy, that's the goal right? So what's up? Anything new or fun going on?
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: [Image: a photography of a group of dogs sitting on top of a lush green field] Not much has changed since we last talked. I'm busy taking care of my pets and spending time with them. It's really fulfilling.
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: I bet it's awesome hanging out with them - do your dogs enjoy going on hikes?
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: [Image: a photo of a dog running in a field with other dogs] My dogs go nuts when we go on hikes! They love exploring new scents and being in nature - it's their happy place. I can tell by their wagging tails and expressions how much they love it. It's so great to see them having so much fun!
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Wow, that's great! I was wondering if you have any tips or tricks for keeping dogs safe when they're out and about?
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: [Image: a photo of a dog with a leash and shoes on] Definitely! Safety is super important for me. I even got them something special. They sure look funny, but it works!
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Awesome to see that you take such good care of your dogs! What else do you do when you walk them?
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: [Image: a photography of a dog catching a frisbee in a field] When I take them out, we usually play fetch with a ball or frisbee. They love chasing it! We also meet other dog owners in the park and have a doggie playdate. It's a great way for me to chat with people and for them to make new friends.
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Wow, looks like fun! They sure look excited about playing fetch!
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: [Image: a photo of a dog wearing a party hat sitting on a couch] They absolutely adore it! They have tons of energy and love meeting new pals at playdates. Plus, they always get excited when I bring those out.
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Aww, that's so cute! Do they enjoy wearing the party hats? And where did you find their playdates?
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: [Image: a photography of a dog jumping through a ring in a park] The hats don't bother them, they just put them on for fun and treats. And the dog park is great place to start! They can run and mingle with other pooches. It's such a fun spot for playdates!
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: That sounds great! Where is it located?
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: It's right by the park we usually walk. It's a great spot with lots of trees and benches for us to watch the dogs play.
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: That's awesome, not too far away then! I'll have to check it out. Thanks for the suggestion!
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Yup! Not at all! Let me know how it goes.
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Sure, I'll let you know. Always great chatting with you! Ttyl.
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Andrew: [Image: a photography of a dog looking through a cage at the camera] Hey! Since we last spoke, I've been looking for a doggo to adopt - browsing websites, visiting shelters and asking friends of theirs. It's been both fun and annoying!
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: [Image: a photo of two dogs running in a field with a ball in their mouth] Sounds like a fun and demanding task! Getting to meet new pups must bring so much happiness. What  do you think you can do to make the process smoother?
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Meeting all these adorable pups has been awesome! For those considering getting a pup, the size of living space and the exercise needs of the breed are important. For me, a person living in an apartment, a smaller dog would be best, but if one is active, consider getting one that loves to play and run.
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: That's some good advice! It's important to consider the space and energy needs of a dog.
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Yeah! Finding a pet-friendly place to live has been tough too. I'm contacting landlords and checking out neighborhoods to find the perfect spot.
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Guessing it's tough to find housing. Any particular part of town you want to live in?
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: I'm looking for a place near a park or woods, so I can stay close to nature and give the dog a large open space to run around
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: [Image: a photography of three dogs running through a field of grass] That's a good plan! I'm lucky to have a park near me - it's great for my pup's walks. Last Friday we took a road trip - we went to a beautiful national park and my dogs had a blast! It was an awesome trip!
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Nice! Glad the pups had a great road trip. Do you take them on road trips often?
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: I take them on road trips once every couple of months. It's a great way for them to explore and stay active.
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Wow, that's awesome! I really wish I could go on a road trip with a furry companion.
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: It's a cool experience. Having your furry friends on a road trip is an amazing experience. They make it really fun and exciting. It's definitely something to look forward to!
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Adding that to my bucket list! Can't wait for the day I actually go on a trip with my dog!
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Good luck with your search! Fingers crossed you find the perfect one.
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Thanks! Your help is much appreciated. I'm still on the lookout for the perfect furry friend.
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Not a problem, I'm glad to help! Good luck with your search!
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Thanks! I'll let you know how it goes.
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Definitely, keep me posted and let me know if you need any suggestions or help.
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Will do! Really apprecieate it.
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Yup! You got it, I'll be expecting a pic of your dog soon! :)
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Haha I can't wait. I'll ttyl, gotta check out another shelter soon.
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Have fun! Ttyl!
events.speaker: Audrey
